# 宮室考

**ID:** KR1d0045
**Custom ID:** ZB1d0040
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V109.5, p801
**Extent:** 2 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 任啟運 (清朝) 撰 1670 - 1744

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Rèn Qǐyùn's 任啟運 (1670–1744) two-juan investigation of the architectural and spatial vocabulary of pre-Qín ritual classical texts, supplementing Lǐ Rúguī's [KR1d0031](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0031) *Yílǐ shìgōng* with substantial expansion. The work organises material under the rubrics: *mén* (gates), *guān* (towers), *cháo* (audience halls), *miào* (temples), *qǐn* (residences), *shú* (gate-side schools), *zhù* (forecourt), *děngwēi* (rank-and-status), *míngwù* (named-things), *mén dàxiǎo guǎngxiá* (gate dimensions), *Míngtáng* (Bright Hall), *Fāngmíng* (Square-Bright), *Bìyōng* (Hoop-Pond royal academy). The Sìkù *tíyào* engages substantial counter-arguments against several of Rèn's specific claims — particularly his identification of *xiāng* (廂) as positions east-and-west of the *fáng*, with *jiāshì* (夾室) east-and-west of the hall — judged not to fit the classical evidence — but acknowledges the work as substantial *kǎozhèng* and a valuable supplement to the *Yílǐ* reading.

**Abstract**

The *Gōngshì kǎo* is one of the principal Qīng-period systematic supplements to Lǐ Rúguī's [KR1d0031](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0031) *Yílǐ shìgōng*. Rèn Qǐyùn's distinctive contribution is the comprehensive topical organisation (gates, towers, audiences, temples, residences, gate-side schools, ranks, named-things, dimensions, *Míngtáng*, *Fāngmíng*, *Bìyōng*) extending beyond Lǐ Rúguī's text-by-text approach. The Sìkù editors mount a substantial counter-argument against Rèn's specific spatial scheme (locating *Dōng-Xī xiāng* east of the *fáng* and *jiāshì* east-and-west of the *táng*) but approve the broader *kǎozhèng* method and several specific clarifications.

The dating "1733–1744" brackets Rèn's late career (1733 *jìnshì*) through his death.

Rèn Qǐyùn was a deputy compiler on the *Qīndìng Sānlǐ yìshū* commission ([KR1d0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0018) [KR1d0037](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0037) [KR1d0068](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0068)); his independent work supplements the official imperial commentary with private investigations.
